heading: Today
text: Partly sunny, with more clouds mixing in throughout the day. Highs from the low to mid 80s, a few upper 80s in the warmest valleys. Light and variable wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy, with river valley fog developing overnight. Lows in the low to mid 60s, nearing 70 along Lake Champlain. Light south wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly cloudy, with rain showers arriving as early as midday in western Vermont, then spreading east. Chance of thunderstorms developing in the afternoon. Highs from the low to mid 80s. Wind becoming south at 5 to 10 mph.
